title: A quarterly ridership report whose totals, rates and caveat all recompute from its table (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv
r = list(csv.DictReader(open('data.csv')))
q2, q3 = r
t = open('report.md').read()
tr = int(q3['trips']) / int(q2['trips']) - 1
assert round(tr * 100, 1) == 15.0 and '15.0%' in t
a = int(q2['trips']) / (int(q2['bikes']) * int(q2['days']))
b = int(q3['trips']) / (int(q3['bikes']) * int(q3['days']))
assert round(a, 2) == 1.51 and round(b, 2) == 1.67 and round((b / a - 1) * 100, 1) == 10.8 and '10.8%' in t
